timingContract.count: prepare + exact count execution, including MATCH/join/Space/Tags predicates
timingContract.top10: prepare + ranked Top10 execution, including MATCH/join/Space/Tags predicates, sort and snippet projection
timingContract.tags: Reusable statement prepared once at startup; per-query execution includes lookup/map/attachment to up to ten hits
timingContract.workerMs: Normalization, predicates, component calls and instrumentation; excludes IPC/HTTP
timingContract.unallocatedTime: workerMs minus timed components includes normalization, SQL construction and instrumentation overhead; normalization is not independently measured
timingContract.parentRoundTripMs: IPC and scheduling plus worker, not HTTP latency
timingContract.filterCost: Not independently measured; filters participate in both count and Top10 plans
timingContract.cache: Reference and profile are separate SQLite connections. Host cache may be warm; profile connection cache is not claimed warm
timingContract.reference: Compatibility anchor and explicit warmup, not a timed optimization baseline
timingContract.quality: Independent source oracle plus exact ordered equality to original worker, not user relevance or ES equivalence

limitations: Sequential isolated diagnostic; no Next, MinIO, HTTP, concurrency or capacity claim
Two new instrumentation files only; no SQL/index/normalization/semantic optimization
Five rotated rounds are descriptive samples; EXPLAIN plans do not assign independent filter or operator runtime cost
No A/B comparison; parent helper must record actual cgroup limits, membership and external timeout
